Median days to completion: median(completion days) over closed requests | population: closed requests | blind spot: Excludes every open request, so the slowest cases are invisible (selection bias / right-censoring).
90th percentile days to completion: p90(completion days) over closed requests | population: closed requests | blind spot: Still closed-only; a backlog of very old open requests is not reflected.

Closure rate within 30 days by intake cohort: count(closed within 30 days) / count(received) | population: all requests received in cohorts with >= 30 days of follow-up before extract | blind spot: Says nothing about how late the remainder are.
Open-case ageing: median and share > 90 days of (extract date - date received) | population: open requests at extract | blind spot: Snapshot at one date; cannot show how the backlog evolved.
Open share: count(open) / count(all) | population: all requests | blind spot: Recent intake is naturally open; compare like-aged cohorts.

Kaplan-Meier median days to completion: time where KM survival S(t) first <= 0.5; open requests censored at age at extract | population: all requests | blind spot: Assumes open requests behave like closed requests of the same age (non-informative censoring).

Naive median of days_to_complete (anti-pattern): median(days_to_complete) over every row | population: all rows in dataset A | blind spot: Mixes completion times (closed) with ages (open). Technically computable, conceptually wrong. Kept only to demonstrate the error.
